- [PREFERENCE] User does not trust fracking companies to properly monitor their own operations.
- [PREFERENCE] User believes that fracking should be completely banned to protect water sources.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fracking involves injecting a mixture of water, sand, and chemicals at high pressure into shale rocks to release natural gas and oil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Marcellus Shale region is one of the largest sources of natural gas in the United States.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is conflicting research on the effect of fracking on groundwater quality in the Marcellus Shale region.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some studies have found higher levels of contaminants such as methane, benzene, and arsenic in groundwater near fracking wells.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many experts agree that the risk of groundwater contamination increases when fracking is not done properly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EPA has developed a groundwater monitoring program that requires fracking companies to test water quality before, during, and after drilling.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EPA conducts its own monitoring to ensure compliance with regulations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many states have established their own rules and monitoring programs to regulate fracking and protect groundwater quality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pennsylvania requires fracking companies to monitor groundwater quality at nearby wells before drilling and for a certain period after drilling is complete.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EPA sets and enforces regulations on fracking operations to safeguard the environment and public health.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some states require companies to perform baseline testing before initiating fracking operations and to regularly report their results.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Pennsylvania, operators are required to submit pre-drilling water quality test reports to the state's Department of Environmental Protection.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Citizens can report suspected violations or contamination to regulatory agencies or file lawsuits against fracking companies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A notable example is the Dimock case in Pennsylvania, where citizens sued a fracking company for groundwater contamination.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The decision to ban fracking is a contentious topic with arguments on both sides.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advocates of fracking suggest it provides affordable, clean energy and creates jobs.
